scope: Single-particle emission using binding as sole available energy is forbidden at this massive-carrier gap. Collective emission is not excluded. Massless angular modes have no such threshold.

null_wave_statement: For a plane outgoing massless phase wave, (partial chi)^2=0 exactly. Spherical waves source the modulus only at subleading1/r^3 and1/r^4 orders; this is asymptotic transparency, not exact finite-radius decoupling.
